_doc: Dead sideboard-card rules, hand-editable. A SIDEBOARD_IN action for
<card> is pruned (training sampling AND plan search, both backends)
when the opponent's REGISTERED 75 contains ZERO cards matching ANY of
the rule's conditions. Only list cards that are 100% dead under the
condition - marginal cards must stay searchable.
Condition forms (dead_unless_opp_has takes one object or a list = OR):
Facts come from the card scripts via train/gen_card_props.py's parser;
note a dual land like Volcanic Island counts as an Island. Consumed by
pending_review: candidate cards whose deadness is a judgment call the
table's maintainer has not made yet (condition: null = no rule active).
Codegen ignores them. REVIEW THESE MANUALLY and promote any you endorse
into rules with a real condition.
